name: brotobooth-website
description: Site vitrine et réservations de Brotobooth (Astro, Cloudflare Worker, D1).

scripts.dev:e2e: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e && astro build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e && wrangler dev --port 8788 --persist-to .wrangler/e2e --test-scheduled --var FAKE_GATEWAYS:1 --var PAYMENT_MODE:simulated --var ACCESS_AUD:local-dev --var BASE_URL:http://localhost:8788
